text.tspan: Micron: strong realized cash; customer deposits are outside this operating cash bridge
Operating cash less cash purchases alone: 32.863B. The company-adjusted measure adds incentives and asset-sale proceeds.
About 12.3B of quarterly customer deposits is classified as financing, not deducted again from operating cash. Q4 had 14 weeks.
Sources: Micron FY26Q4 results, official deck p. 43 and script pp. 8-9. Financial statements are unaudited.
